from models import db, Post, Comment

# This test demonstrates the regression: Post changes trigger the handler, Comment does not.

def test_post_is_tracked(app=None):
    # this is only a placeholder, agent should turn this into a real test with a test app and db session
    p = Post(body="hello")
    db.session.add(p)
    # after commit, Post.before_commit/after_commit will run because we registered Post handlers
    db.session.commit()

def test_comment_is_not_tracked(app=None):
    c = Comment(body="world")
    db.session.add(c)
    # BUG: no event listener was registered for Comment, so index will not be updated
    db.session.commit()

test_description: This input shows a buggy event-binding setup where SQLAlchemy session events are registered only for Post.before_commit/after_commit. When Comment also inherits from SearchableMixin, its changes are not indexed. The agent should generalize the listener registration to cover all SearchableMixin subclasses or to bind at session-level with isinstance checks.
